evidence.observation: Reboiler heater reads ~443-447 °C, implausibly high versus T703 vessel at ~82 °C
Column heater temperatures decay monotonically (123→78, 118→74, 125→87) over 20 min, i.e. column section heating is falling off
Distillate and reflux flows essentially zero/noise throughout; no product take-off or reflux established
Column pressure drop stays ~1.0 mbar, indicating negligible vapour traffic
Top/section temperatures flat at ~74 °C, no separation profile developing

args.missing_evidence: Heater power/setpoint data and T701 sensor verification (thermocouple check) to distinguish a runaway/miswired reboiler heater sensor from genuine loss of boil-up; plus a distillate composition sample once reflux is established.
